product.name: Monoprice 4K High Speed HDMI Cable - 4K@60Hz HDR HDR10 Dolby Vision 18Gbps YUV 444 28AWG With Ferrite Cores 15 Feet Black
product.description: Reliably transmit stunning 4K@60Hz video signals to your cutting‑edge UHDTV with the Monoprice 4K High-Speed HDMI Cable ‑ 18Gbps. This Select Series cable is designed to deliver exceptional performance and ensure a seamless viewing experience.Equipped with an impressive 18Gbps data throughput, this HDMI cable enables swift and smooth data transfer, allowing you to enjoy your favorite content without any lag or loss in quality. The inclusion of ferrite cores provides added protection against electromagnetic and radio frequency interference, ensuring a stable and interference‑free signal transmission.Crafted with 28AWG copper conductors, this cable guarantees optimal signal strength and integrity, minimizing any signal degradation. The gold plated connectors further enhance conductivity and durability, ensuring a reliable and long‑lasting connection between your devices.One of the standout features of this HDMI cable is its support for HDR and HDR10 technology. HDR, or High Dynamic Range, enhances the visual experience by delivering a more realistic image with improved contrast, brightness, and colors. With HDR, your TV can display a wider range of colors and achieve greater accuracy, resulting in a more vibrant and lifelike picture. The expanded contrast ratio brings out finer details in both bright and dark scenes, while the enhanced color accuracy ensures that the on‑screen colors closely resemble real‑life colors.Furthermore, this cable supports Dolby Vision™, a premium HDR format that takes your viewing experience to the next level. Dolby Vision optimizes brightness, contrast, and color settings on a frame‑by‑frame basis, resulting in stunning visuals that truly captivate your senses. With this HDMI cable, you can unlock the full potential of Dolby Vision™ and enjoy cinematic‑quality visuals in the comfort of your home.The Monoprice 4K High‑Speed HDMI Cable also offers full YCbCr 4:4:4 chroma sampling at 4K resolution, delivering pristine color reproduction and ensuring every hue and shade is faithfully represented on your screen. Whether you're watching movies, playing games, or editing photos and videos, this cable ensures that you see every detail in its truest form.In summary, the Monoprice 4K High‑Speed HDMI Cable ‑ 18Gbps is a feature‑rich cable that delivers exceptional performance and reliability. With its 18Gbps data throughput, ferrite cores, 28AWG copper conductors, gold plated connectors, HDR and HDR10 support, full YCbCr 4:4:4 chroma sampling, and compatibility with Dolby Vision, this cable is the perfect companion for your UHDTV, ensuring that you experience the highest quality visuals with every use.This High Speed HDMI Cable supports the following general features:18Gbps data throughputFerrite cores help protect against electromagnetic and radio frequency interference28AWG copper conductorsGold plated connectorsSupports HDR and HDR10: HDR is an acronym for High Dynamic Range. TVs with HDR show a better, more realistic image with more contrast, brightness, and colors than ever before. HDR significantly expands contrast ratio and color accuracy. Contrast ratio is related to how bright or dark a screen is and color accuracy is how closely the colors on the screen match colors in real life. Bright images seem brighter, with more depth.Full YCbCr 4:4:4 Chroma Sampling at 4KSupports Dolby Vision™It supports the following HDMI features:Supports all HDMI® 2.0 resolutions up to 4K (3840x2160p @60Hz), including 3D and Multi View videoSupports the 21:9 cinema aspect ratioSupports up to 32 audio channels and a 1536 kHz audio sampling rateSimultaneous delivery of dual video streams to multiple users on the same screenSupports SA-CD, DVD-Audio, DTS-HD Master Audio™, Dolby TrueHD™, and other high-definition audio standardsSupports Deep Color, up to 16-bits per channel, including the Sony® x.v.Color™; standardSupports extended CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) commands and functions, the HDMI Ethernet Channel, and the Audio Return Channel featuresSupport Files: Diagram Sept. 30, 2022HDMI®, the HDMI Logo, and High-Definition Multimedia Interface are trademarks or registered trademarks of HDMI Licensing LLC in the United States and other countries.
